question: 查询各分行信用卡交易金额
sql: SELECT b.branch_name, SUM(t.txn_amount_cny) AS amount FROM dwd_card_transaction t JOIN dim_branch b ON t.branch_id = b.branch_id WHERE t.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.transaction_status = 'POSTED' GROUP BY b.branch_name

question: 查询近30天信用卡交易笔数
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS count FROM dwd_card_transaction WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT' AND transaction_status = 'POSTED' AND transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
